items_flat.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic提交S-1，擬以ANT代號在納斯達克上市
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic filed a Form S-1 with the SEC on October 26 for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT. The filing discloses first-half 2026 revenue of about $16.3 billion (up sharply year-over-year) and a large net loss driven mainly by convertible note revaluations; it also covers training pauses and security incidents involving agents.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於10月26日向SEC提交S-1表格，擬在納斯達克以ANT代號發行A類普通股。文件揭露2026上半年營收約163億美元（年增大幅），淨虧損主要來自可轉換債券重估；並涵蓋訓練暫停與代理相關安全事件。
items_flat.analysis_en: The filing gives the first detailed public look at Anthropic’s economics and risk factors, testing investor appetite for a pure-play frontier lab amid high compute commitments and disclosed safety issues. Actual valuation and timing remain subject to market conditions and further amendments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此申請提供Anthropic經濟數據與風險因素的首次詳細公開視角，測試投資人對純前沿實驗室的興趣，同時面對高額算力承諾與揭露的安全問題。實際估值與時程仍取決於市場狀況與後續修訂。
items_flat.quote: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. Anthropic intends to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.”
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，Anthropic, PBC向美國證券交易委員會提交S-1註冊聲明，涉及其擬議的A類普通股首次公開發行。Anthropic擬在納斯達克全球精選市場以「ANT」代號掛牌其A類普通股。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands Oracle partnership to bring apps into ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI擴大與Oracle合作，將應用程式帶入ChatGPT
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced an expanded partnership with Oracle on October 27 to integrate Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings with OpenAI models. New products include Oracle AI Workspace for unified workflows, AI Security Mesh for vulnerability testing, App Composer for building apps with Codex, and an SMB Bundle with credits.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於10月27日宣布擴大與Oracle的合作，將Oracle應用程式與資料整合進ChatGPT，並以OpenAI模型驅動新的Oracle產品。新產品包括Oracle AI Workspace統一工作流程、AI Security Mesh漏洞測試、使用Codex的App Composer，以及含額度的SMB Bundle。
items_flat.analysis_en: This deepens enterprise embedding of frontier models into existing ERP and cloud systems, lowering adoption friction for large organizations already on Oracle. Success depends on real-world governance, permissions, and whether agentic workflows deliver measurable productivity gains beyond demos.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這加深了前沿模型嵌入現有ERP與雲端系統，降低已使用Oracle的大型組織採用門檻。成敗取決於實際治理、權限控制，以及代理工作流程是否能帶來超越示範的可衡量生產力提升。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and powering new Oracle products and services with OpenAI models and products.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI與Oracle將Oracle應用程式與資料帶入ChatGPT，並以OpenAI模型與產品驅動新的Oracle產品與服務。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra for fast, efficient computer use
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6.1 Terra，提供快速高效的電腦操作
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on October 26, a fast model emphasizing visual reasoning, computer use, and writing at lower cost. It is available in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API (gpt-6.1-terra) at $1/$5 per million input/output tokens, with reported gains on agent and factuality benchmarks versus prior Terra versions.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於10月26日發布GPT-6.1 Terra，這是一款強調視覺推理、電腦操作與寫作的快速模型，成本更低。它在ChatGPT Work、Codex與API（gpt-6.1-terra）中可用，定價為每百萬輸入/輸出token 1美元/5美元，並在代理與事實性基準上相對前代Terra有所提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: By cutting price roughly in half while improving speed and factuality on routine professional tasks, Terra aims to make high-volume computer-use agents practical. Independent evaluations will determine whether the claimed efficiency gains hold outside OpenAI’s benchmarks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過約減半價格同時提升速度與事實性，Terra旨在讓高量電腦操作代理更實用。獨立評估將決定所稱效率提升是否在OpenAI基準之外成立。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use alongside clearer, more natural writing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出GPT-6.1 Terra，這是一款結合詳細視覺推理與精確電腦操作、並具備更清晰自然寫作的快速高效模型。
